title: cheilanthes lucida
intro: Cheilanthes lucida, commonly known as the shiny rock fern, is a species of fern in the family Pteridaceae. It is native to the tropical regions of the Pacific Islands and has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties. Cheilanthes lucida has been reported to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can aid in the treatment of conditions such as arthritis and skin disorders. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenes, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
